metadata.summary: Alex Mitchell provided an injury worry for England ahead of the Nations Championship as the scrum-half was forced off during Northampton's 28-14 win against Gloucester on Saturday evening.

messages.text: Alcaraz reaches first Vienna final as De Minaur upsets Zverev

metadata.summary: Carlos Alcaraz reached the Vienna Open final for the first time after beating Daniil Medvedev 6-4 7-6 (7-2) on Saturday. He will face Alex de Minaur, who upset Alexander Zverev in the final.
metadata.content: Vienna Open: Carlos Alcaraz beats Daniil Medvedev to reach first final as Alex de Minaur stuns Alexander Zverev | Tennis News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Vienna Open: Carlos Alcaraz beats Daniil Medvedev to reach first final as Alex de Minaur stuns Alexander Zverev Carlos Alcaraz beats Daniil Medvedev as Alex de Minaur stuns Alexander Zverev to set up Vienna Open final; Watch Alcaraz vs De Minaur in Vienna Open final live on Sky Sports Tennis on Sunday at 1pm ; watch ATP Paris Masters live on Sky Sports from Nov 2 Saturday 31 October 2026 20:10, UK Image: Carlos Alcaraz is through to the Vienna Open final for the first time, and will face Alex de Minaur on Sunday for the title Carlos Alcaraz reached the Vienna Open final for the first time after beating Daniil Medvedev 6-4 7-6 (7-2) on Saturday. He will face Alex de Minaur, who upset Alexander Zverev in the final. Alcaraz reached the 37th tour-level final of his career and his fifth of the year, while extending his winning streak at ATP 500 events to 25 matches. The second seed took the opening set after Medvedev double-faulted to hand him set point. The Russian responded strongly in the second, however, forcing a tie-break. With neither player able to establish a decisive advantage, Alcaraz unleashed a barrage of powerful groundstrokes in the breaker to seal victory in 96 minutes. messages.text: Naderi strikes late to send Rangers into League Cup final

metadata.summary: Ryan Naderi's dramatic late strike broke down Aberdeen for a 1-0 win to book Rangers a place in the Premier Sports Cup final.
metadata.content: Rangers 1-0 Aberdeen: Ryan Naderi strikes late to send Gers into Premier Sports Cup final | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Rangers 1-0 Aberdeen: Ryan Naderi strikes late to send Gers into Premier Sports Cup final Report as Rangers book spot in Scottish League Cup final thanks to a late strike from Ryan Naderi Saturday 31 October 2026 20:10, UK Image: Ryan Naderi scored the goal to send Rangers into the League Cup final Ryan Naderi's dramatic late strike broke down Aberdeen for a 1-0 win to book Rangers a place in the Premier Sports Cup final. The resilient Dons restricted Derek McInnes's side to one shot on target in a low-quality first half, but the Ibrox side picked up the pace after the break. Stephen Robinson's side survived relentless pressure at times but in the 83rd minute, the big striker redirected a strike from James Penrice into the net for his eight goal of the season which settled the semi-final at Barclays Hampden. Rangers will face Hearts or Hibernian in the December 13 final, with the Edinburgh sides facing each other at the national stadium on Sunday.
